description: This file implements cryptographic signing functionalities for the confui component, including HMAC generation and communication with a secure environment signing server. It defines classes and functions for signing messages, connecting to a socket-based signing server, and handling responses.

classes.name: HMacImplementation
classes.description: Provides static method for computing HMAC-SHA256 signatures.

methods.name: HMacImplementation::hmac256
methods.description: Computes an HMAC-SHA256 over multiple buffers using a provided key.

methods.name: TestSign
methods.description: Generates a test HMAC signature for a message using a fixed key.

methods.name: Sign
methods.description: Connects to a secure environment signing server to request a signature for a message.
